models.description: A smooth, translucent sky-blue Aquamarine stone cut from the cypress frame of King David's own harp (Light Blue — Spirit of Might, Isaiah 11:2). Given at Well 1 (Sec. 48). Once per book: treat your 2d6 Stand roll as an automatic 10, OR pass one Favor Test as Blessed without losing Favor, OR hear which learned KJV Scroll resonates against a Stronghold.

models.description: The weathered ten-stringed Bethlehem cypress kinnor inlaid with an Aquamarine stone and carrying one snapped string from the day David shielded his brother in the dust and left his royal circlet on the ground. 'The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.' (Psalm 51:17 KJV)

models.description: Grace Mi-ran Cho's old portable tape player, its plastic door taped shut since the month before she entered the hospital two years ago, alongside the crumpled paper bearing the four unpolished, unproduced notes that Elias, Adaeze, Brother Matthias, Talia, and the Fellow-Traveler hum on the floor of the Sea of Glass to dissolve Heaviness (#20).
